translation:
The genealogist's register records that Shri Jivanji Maharaj manifested (pragat) in the village Goriyad, at eleven years of age, in Samvat 1660, on Shravan Sud 8.

The samagam (satsang record) states: In Samvat 1660, on the eighth day (ashtami) of the bright half of Shravan, in the greater region of Gujarat, within the Kanhanav circle (mandal), lies the village called Goriyad — also known as Ghayaj — where the Vaishnav Jivandasji came, for the welfare of the soul. There the dharma of Namdev and Kabirji became manifest, and love arose to sing its glory (leela), from the age of eleven onward.

There is no surviving memorial to him in Goriyad itself, but devotees lived in the neighbouring villages of Darapura, Bhoj, and Samiyala, and presumably in Goriyad as well. Today, the devotee Ishwarbhai (Nanabhai) Bhagvanbhai and his family, living in Shiyabaug in Vadodara, are known by the title "Goriyada." Thus Goriyad, as the place where our faith first arose, is a sacred place of merit.
